# SwiftRise

> SwiftRise is an all-in-one event management platform for organizers, built by Verto Technologies in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It covers event planning, booth layouts, registration, ticketing, on-site QR check-in, badge printing, live agendas, live streaming, polls and surveys, and attendee networking — with dedicated iOS and Android apps.

Key facts:
- Winner of Gold at the 15th edition of the Global Eventex Awards, on its very first entry.
- At the ZATCA Conference 2024, SwiftRise achieved an average check-in time under 10 seconds and 100% registration accuracy across four parallel entry gates.
- Trusted at events by ZATCA, Hewar Group, and SAMI.
- Supports Arabic and English content and Saudi-based data hosting for cybersecurity compliance.
